items.title: `capacityFS` embeds `vfs
items.body: `capacityFS` embeds `vfs.FS` without implementing `Unwrap()`. It therefore forwards the underlying filesystem’s `Unwrap()` instead of returning that filesystem, violating the VFS wrapper contract. For `NewCapacityFS(vfs.Default, validUsage)`, the inherited method returns nil, so `vfs.Root` incorrectly returns the capacity wrapper. The existing blob provider consequently sets `reportsFileMetadata=false` (`blobstore/provider_fs.go:114,518`) and rejects supported modification-time writes with `ErrModTimeNotSupported` (`:180`). This changes behavior beyond capacity reporting.
items.suggestion: Implement `func (f *capacityFS) Unwrap() vfs.FS { return f.FS }`. Test that `vfs.Root` preserves the original filesystem for both native and memory backing.
